en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply on 2026-10-15
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **3 own commits** across two repos, plus 14 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 2 own commits updated agent docs to explain commit-attribution aliases and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases for non-GitHub account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, 1 own commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. No pull requests or reviews were filed. On issues, 4 actions were recorded in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened #4920 about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so 其他 stays at 0%, commented on #4111 about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied, and both commented on and closed #4346 about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. In discussions, the user commented in existing discussion #4821 titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" in `openchamber/openchamber`. No releases were published and no replies were received. No section was truncated.

zh.headline: 2026-10-15：3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在两个仓库中共完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 14 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，均位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，2 次本人提交分别更新了 agents 文档以说明提交归属别名，并修复了 daily 脚本使提交归属支持别名、兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，1 次本人提交打了 `v1.15.5` 版本标签。当日未提交任何 PR 或 review。issue 方面在 `openchamber/openchamber` 记录了 4 次操作：新开 #4920，指出上下文面板的 breakdown 条把整场会话估算除以最后一条消息的输入，导致「其他」始终为 0%；在 #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；在 #4346 上留言并关闭该 issue，该 issue 涉及 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 在 `d9fbf6b` 中被移除后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。讨论方面，用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的既有讨论 #4821「[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel」中留言。当日无发布、无收到的回复，各分区均未触发截断。
